title: Warm Buttery Jamaican Spinach Paella
description: A creamy and buttery Jamaican dish featuring spinach, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a paella pan with reduced sodium.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large paella pan over medium heat until melted.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until they are softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the jerk seasoning and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is coated in the butter and spice mixture.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the chopped spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then sprinkle with grated coconut if desired.
Serve the paella hot, straight from the pan.
